ValidationRule.description: Checks whether Vehicle ID is empty or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c ), NOT( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name, 'Digital Hub' ) ), OR( Account.BillingCountry = 'Brazil', Account.BillingCountry = 'Paraguay' ), OR( ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Incorrect Label'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Invoice Adjustments'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Incorrect Product'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Product Concern'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Weight Discrepancy'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Delivery Delay'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Demurrage'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Diversion'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Driver Verification/Change'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Equipment Failure'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Incorrect Destination'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Incorrect UOM'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Missing Cargo'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Mode of Transportation'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Route / Directions'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Ship Date / Scheduling'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c, 'Warehouse' ) ), AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Status, 'Closed' ), ISPICKVAL( Status, 'Closure Pending' ) ), ISBLANK( PMC_SS_VehicleId__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Vehicle Id cannot be empty for this especific Issue Reason when the Account associated is a South American Customer
